note: Reports the environment the run uses: on_slurm true, gpu_count 1, default_partition equal to @PARTITION, project_root equal to @PROJECT, call_log set, and all four reference_files with exists true.
Lists the models loaded in a fresh server, which is an empty object.

Extracts 24 bp windows of every ChIP-Atlas peak with the genome taken from TFBS_GENOME_FASTA (no genome_fasta argument), plus one GC-matched negative per peak; good is num_peaks_extracted close to num_peaks_input (34,700 in the 2026-10-13 run), has_scores true and unfilled_bins empty.
Combines the peak windows (label 1) and the GC-matched windows (label 0) into one balanced set; good is num_positive equal to num_negative.
Splits the classification set 64/16/20 into train, val and test; good is three non-zero counts and an output_dir ending in chipatlas_24bp_gc_dataset.

Turns the MACS2 scores of BED column 5 (scores.pt of the extraction) into log2(x+1) regression labels; good is num_sequences equal to the extracted peaks and a smaller spread in score_stats_after than in score_stats_before.
One-hot encodes four inline 24 bp sites with labels and their reverse complements; good is shape [8, 4, 24] and files with seqs and labels.

Cuts the ref and alt 24 bp windows of chr8:132862782 T>G (the CACG core mutant of the TG promoter site, demo_chr8:830 in the bundled demo) from the explicit genome_fasta; good is num_extracted 1 and no ref_mismatches, which also confirms the genome is GRCh38 with chr names.
Samples 200 peaks (seed 7) with 200 GC-matched negatives as a small scoring set for tfbs_predict and tfbs_classify_metrics; good is 200 extracted windows and 200 negatives.
Samples 1000 ChIP-Atlas peaks as 300 bp windows; its regions.bed is the small peak set that bounds the FoldX work of tfbs_disease_variant_validation; good is 1000 extracted windows.

Writes the VCNNBpnet config for the dataset with classify inferred from the 0/1 labels; good is classify true, scaling_method none, input_length 24 and checkpoint_path @PROJECT/saved_models/chipatlas_24bp_gc/none/best_VCNNBpnet.ckpt.

Trains the classifier on this node's GPU, capped at 6 epochs through extra_args; good is exit_code 0, checkpoint_exists true, epochs_run 6 or fewer, no warning and metrics.val_auc near 0.78 (0.787 at best epoch 2 on 2026-10-13).

Writes a second config with an explicit output_path, checkpoint_dir, max_epochs and patience, so the SLURM training job cannot overwrite the checkpoint the later steps use; good is checkpoint_path under @WORK/slurm_train/checkpoints.

Submits the second config as a SLURM GPU job (config mode) with 3 DataLoader workers through extra_args; good is mode config, a job_id, and a generated_script with --partition=@PARTITION, --gres=gpu:1, --cpus-per-task=4 and --mem=16G.

Submits a test-split evaluation of the trained checkpoint to the partition from TFBS_SLURM_PARTITION (no partition argument); good is a job_id and an sbatch_script with --partition=@PARTITION whose command writes @WORK/validate/validation_smoke.csv.

Checks the sweep tool up to its WandB requirement; without the tracking extra or a wandb login the answer is an error that names the fix and creates no sweep, and with a login it creates a one-trial sweep and submits one agent job.
Loads the Lightning checkpoint trained above; good is checkpoint_format lightning, classify true, input_length 24 and device cuda.

Loads the released FLANK inference checkpoint, the one format training here cannot produce and the only regression model of the run; good is checkpoint_format inference, classify false and scaling_params from the file.
Lists the two loaded models; good is the keys trained and flank.
Scores the 200 sampled peak windows from their .pt file; good is 200 scores between 0 and 1.
Scores the 200 GC-matched negative windows; good is 200 scores, on average lower than the peak scores.
Computes ROC-AUC and PR-AUC from the two score lists; good is roc_auc clearly above 0.5 (the sampled peaks overlap the training set, so it is optimistic).
Scores a 60 bp sequence in window_mode; good is one best_scores value and a 24 bp best_sequences entry.
Scores the variant's ref window with FLANK; good is units label (log2 fold change) and a score near 1.07, the value of the same window in the bundled demo.
Scores the variant's alt window with FLANK; good is a score near -0.54, about 1.6 log2 units below the ref window.
Runs DeepLiftShap with 10 shuffles on the four sites; good is shape [4, 4, 24] and an attributions.pt file.
Runs saturation mutagenesis on the .pt file tfbs_preprocess wrote (sites plus reverse complements); good is shape [8, 4, 24] and an ism_scores.pt file.
Inserts the NKX2-1 core CACTTGA into 20 random backgrounds; good is 20 delta_predictions and, for a classifier that learned the motif, a positive mean_delta.
Calls seqlets on the four sites and annotates them against @MOTIF with TOMTOM; good is a seqlets.tsv file and no annotation_error (num_seqlets may be 0 with a note).
Scores pairwise epistasis over positions 8 to 15 of the variant's ref window with FLANK; good is num_pairs_analyzed 28, num_double_mutants 252 and units label.
Summarises the first-layer filters on the four sites; good is num_pfms above 0 and the three files filter_summary, meme and top_subsequences.
Scans the four sites and the 60 bp sequence with @MOTIF at p < 1e-3; good is backend meme on the cluster (memelite without the fimo program) and total_hits above 0.
Downloads PDB 9U19 from RCSB, with AlphaFold DB P43699 as the fallback; good is source pdb and has_dna true, while a node without outbound HTTPS returns an error listing both attempts.

Runs FoldX AnalyseComplex on the registered repaired complex without repairing it again, protein chain A against DNA chains C and D (the chain IDs of the repaired NKX2-1 complex of the study; 9U19 from RCSB has protein C and DNA A,B); good is a negative interaction_energy and repaired_structure_path null.

Scores the one window of the 24 bp region (window = the 11 bp DNA of the structure, step 50), CTCACTTGACC at the TG promoter, which holds the NKX2-1 core CACTTGA and the step 7 variant position, with FoldX BuildModel and AnalyseComplex; good is num_windows 1, num_scored 1 and a bigWig file.

Runs the NN-only ChIP-Atlas benchmark directly, finding the trained checkpoint through the models_dir lookup (saved_models/chipatlas_24bp_gc, falling back from standardize to none with a warning); good is mode direct and classification_vs_negatives.csv among the files.

Runs NN, FIMO and FoldX on 20 windows each of NKX2-1 and GATA1 directly, with the motif and PDB taken from TFBS_MOTIF_FILE and TFBS_FOLDX_PDB; good is mode direct and an auc_summary.csv with a FoldX row (or at least non-empty FoldX values in raw_scores.csv), since the pipeline skips FoldX without an error when foldx is not on the server's PATH and turns a failed FoldX run into NaN, so is_error false alone does not show that FoldX ran.

Runs the ReMap validation directly on 20 peaks seen in at least 4 experiments against their shuffled copies, with motif, PDB and genome from the environment; good is a summary with rows NN trained, FIMO and FoldX, each with n_pos 20 and n_neg 20, and the stdout line FoldX OK reporting pos 20/20 and neg 20/20, since a failed FoldX run becomes NaN without an error (the FoldX row needs at least 5 scored on each side).

Runs the ClinVar check directly on the 1000 sampled peak windows with NN, FIMO (motif from the environment) and FoldX (PDB from the environment); good is mode direct with clinvar_snvs.csv, summary_all_methods.csv and non-NaN foldx_ddG values in combined_results.csv, since the pipeline writes NaN FoldX columns without an error when foldx is not on the server's PATH or a FoldX run fails; the summary has rows only for methods with at least 10 scored variants and both classes present.
Asks the scheduler about the training job submitted about half an hour earlier; good is a state such as COMPLETED, RUNNING or PENDING (a long GPU queue).
Reads both logs of the training job; good is log_sources naming where each file was found and, once the job has run, Lightning output in the content.

arguments.context: tfbs_validate smoke test of the trained classifier

note: Requests monitoring of the validation job; good is check_interval_seconds 600, a next_check slurm_status call and the list of terminal_states.
Reads both logs of the validation job, which tfbs_validate writes next to its CSV; good is paths under @WORK/validate.
Submits the trivial @SCRIPT with one argument and a job name flag; good is a job_id and a submit_command that ends in the script path and 20.
Checks the trivial job right after submission; good is a state, usually PENDING or RUNNING.
Submits a ten-minute sleep given as script_body (without a #! line, which the tool adds) from @WORK; good is a job_id and a script_path of the temporary file.
Cancels the sleep job; good is cancelled true.
Checks the cancelled job; good is state CANCELLED (or a completing state seconds after the cancel).
Reads the stdout of the trivial job; good is its log path in the script's directory, with content once the job has run and a not-found note while it is still pending.
